`gh` has been installed:

```bash
$ gh --version
gh version 2.104.0 (2026-11-12)
```

*(Note: Homebrew isn't available in this Linux environment, so the binary was installed directly to [gh](file:///home/agent/.local/bin/gh).)*

> [!TIP]
> If you are looking to put this project on GitHub or connect a repository, you don't need to configure it via the CLI: simply tap the **GitHub icon at the top of the chat** to connect a repository, and your entire project history will be synced there automatically.
